text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angola could sign in 1997 a transport and communications agreement with the Southern African Development Community group of countries.
- Coffee production in Angola could reach 10,000 tonnes in the 1996/97 agricultural year, the Secretary of State for Coffee Gilberto Mbuta Lutukuta said.
- An adviser for the former rebel UNITA movement, Abel Chivukuvuku said the peace in Angola was irreversible.
